source.sqlReaderQuery:
--Declaring Variables

DECLARE @PhoneNo    AS NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @var_AB_Failure_EmailTo      AS NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @var_AB_Failure_DefaultEmailTo AS NVARCHAR(1000)
DECLARE @var_AB_Failure_DefaultPhone   AS NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @var_AB_Failure_UseDefaultYN   AS NVARCHAR(1)

--Setting Up Variables
 SET @var_AB_Failure_EmailTo = (SELECT ConfiguredValue FROM ETL_Management.dbo.DWParameters WHERE ConfigurationFilter = 'var_AB_Failure_EmailTo')
 SET @var_AB_Failure_DefaultEmailTo = (SELECT ConfiguredValue FROM ETL_Management.dbo.DWParameters WHERE ConfigurationFilter = 'var_AB_Failure_DefaultEmailTo')
 SET @var_AB_Failure_DefaultPhone     = (SELECT ConfiguredValue FROM ETL_Management.dbo.DWParameters WHERE ConfigurationFilter = 'var_AB_Failure_DefaultPhone')
 SET @var_AB_Failure_UseDefaultYN = (SELECT ConfiguredValue FROM ETL_Management.dbo.DWParameters WHERE ConfigurationFilter = 'var_AB_Failure_UseDefaultYN')
 SET @PhoneNo = (SELECT TOP 1 Contact_SupportA.PhoneNumber
                 FROM ETL_Management.callout.CalloutTimetable TimeTable
                 INNER JOIN ETL_Management.callout.CalloutContacts Contact_SupportA ON TimeTable.SupportA_ID = Contact_SupportA.SupportID
                 WHERE ActiveIndicator = 1)

  IF @var_AB_Failure_UseDefaultYN = 'Y'
  BEGIN
     SET @PhoneNo = @var_AB_Failure_DefaultPhone
	 SET @var_AB_Failure_EmailTo = @var_AB_Failure_DefaultEmailTo
  END

  select @PhoneNo as contactphone,@var_AB_Failure_EmailTo as contactemail
